full_judgment:
Amirul Kabir Chowdhury J: SM Iqbal Hossain plaintiff-petitioner seeks leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated 27-1-2004 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 6467 of 2002 making the Rule absolute setting aside the judgment and decree dated 16-10-2002 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Mymensingh in Other Appeal No. 54 of 2002 who affirmed the judgment and decree dated 7-2-2002 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar Mymensingh in Other Class Suit No. 205 of 2000. 

 4. The trial Court by the impugned judgment and decree dated 7-2-2002 decreed the suit. The respondents preferred Other Appeal No. 54 of 2002. The lower appellate Court also affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court and thus dismissed the appeal. 

 5. The defendant-respondents moved the High Court Division under section 115 (1) of the Code of Civil Procedure and a Single Bench of the High Court Division after hearing the parties made the Rule absolute, thereby setting side the judgment and decree passed by the lower appellate Court who affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court and consequently, the suit stands dismissed. 

 11. He further submits that the respondents considered the replies to the show cause notices and charges indicted against the plaintiff-petitioner and the report of the inquiry committee and thus removed him legally and the trial Court as well as the lower appellate Court without considering this vital aspect passed the judgment and decree which has correctly been reversed by the High Court Division considering the facts, circumstances and evidence on record. 

 25.Taking clue from the above decision the learned Advocate submits strenuously that considering the act of misconduct the Bank has decided to remove the plaintiff and as such there is no legal reason for the Bank to retain the delinquent since he had lost the confidence of the Batik In this view of the matter, the trial Court as well as the lower appellate Court committed illegality in decreeing the suit.
